twitter_title: The Unspeakable Siming & The Mystery of Ji Zai
twitter_description: After defeating the Dice, Li Huowang is not alone. The Unspeakable's influence is revealed, and a figure named 'Ji Zai' appears in his room.

lore_anchors.definition: A special Siming that can descend to the mortal world when other gods cannot. It taught the Chief Astrologer the art of illusion but remains utterly indifferent to human affairs.
A mysterious figure whose name means "Season's Calamity." They are seen inside Li Huowang's room after the battle, raising questions about their true identity and purpose.
A tangible, parasitic manifestation of a dynasty’s right to rule. The Emperor and the Vein are one, and controlling it means controlling the "truth" of that world.
In this novel, it is a stolen fragment of divine power that props up reality. It is a curse as much as a blessing, requiring immense sacrifice to maintain.
